verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own docs state that no payment method is required and that there are no token limits. Independent community reports corroborate a free-forever 1GB cloud cluster with no credit card. Prototyping is also free through the Apache-2.0 self-hosted Docker image and an in-memory POC mode. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free cloud tier's exact quotas (the 1GB size and the resource limits come only from community reports), and first-party detail on the in-memory/local mode in the pack.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: free tier with a free forever 1GB cluster for trying out, no credit card required
has a slightly more flexible free cloud tier
One of the big advantages of Qdrant is how easy it is to do a POC because it allows an 'in-memory' version similar to sqlite.
